title: Component characterization of Zanthoxylum nitidum extract and its anti-colitis effect through regulating PPARgamma/NF-kappaB/iNOS signaling pathway and gut microbiota.
authors: Lu, Qiang; Wen, Xia; Yang, Fan; Chen, Haohui; Li, Cailan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究两面针提取物通过PPARγ/NF-κB/iNOS通路和肠道菌群缓解结肠炎，仅含分子对接初步分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic, recurrent inflammatory disease of the gastrointestinal tract, for which there are currently no effective therapeutical targets or curative agents. Zanthoxylum nitidum (Roxb.) DC., known as "liangmianzhen" in China, is a woody liana plant belonging to the Rutaceae family. Its dried root is widely used as a traditional Chinese herbal medicine that possesses anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, analgesic, and gastrointestinal protective properties. However, its protective effect against UC is still unclassified. This study aims to investigate the active ingredients, therapeutic efficacy, and probable mechanism of Z. nitidum root in experimental UC. An ethanol extract of Z. nitidum root (ZNE) was prepared, and its chemical composition was characterized. A murine UC model was established via affording 3 % dextran sulfate sodium (DSS), a well-established method to induce colitis resembling human UC. Disease condition was monitored to assess the efficacy of ZNE. ELISA, qRT-PCR, immunohistochemistry, Western blotting and molecular docking were used to elucidate the potential mechanism of ZNE against UC. Additionally, bacterial 16S rRNA gene sequencing was used to assess changes in gut microbiota. Component characterization indicated that the main components of ZNE are alkaloids, including magnoflorine, diosmin, hesperidin, sanguinarine, nitidine chloride, chelerythrine, skimmianine, and L-sesamin. Animal experiment displayed that ZNE treatment prominently attenuated the manifestations of DSS-elicited colitis, reduced DAI scores and histological damage, which exhibited more effectiveness than positive drug 5-ASA. Furthermore, ZNE markedly decreased pro-inflammatory cytokine levels while enhancing anti-inflammatory factors. Mechanistically, ZNE remarkably regulated the PPARgamma/NF-kappaB/iNOS signaling pathway by irritating PPARgamma, inhibiting IkappaBalpha phosphorylation, and preventing NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation, thereby suppressing iNOS expression. However, the role of ZNE in alleviating UC and regulating PPARgamma/NF-kappaB/iNOS signaling pathways was partially abolished by treatment with PPAR-gamma antagonist GW9662, indicating that ZNE activated PPARgamma to exert its activities. Molecular docking analysis revealed that the above eight alkaloids from ZNE demonstrated significant binding affinity to PPARgamma by interacting with critical amino acid residues in its active site. Additionally, ZNE alleviates UC by restoring gut microbiota balance, specifically by promoting the proportion of beneficial bacteria such as Bacteroidetes, Porphyromonadaceae, Prevotellaceae and Akkermansia_muciniphila, while reducing the Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratio and the abundance of Proteobacteria, Enterobacteriaceae, Bacteroides, Bacteroides_acidifaciens and Escherichia. Correlation analysis results suggested that these altered bacteria are closely related to the colitis-related parameters. In conclusion, this study is the first to demonstrate that ZNE exerts significant protective effects against UC, and the main active ingredients of ZNE are alkaloids. Its anti-colitis mechanism involves modulation of the PPARgamma/NF-kappaB/iNOS signal pathway and restoration of gut microbiota homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 溃疡性结肠炎（UC）是一种慢性、复发性胃肠道炎症性疾病，目前尚无有效的治疗靶点或治愈药物。两面针（Zanthoxylum nitidum (Roxb.) DC.），在中国被称为“两面针”，属于芸香科（Rutaceae）木质藤本植物。其干燥根部广泛用作传统中草药，具有抗炎、抗菌、镇痛和胃肠道保护作用。然而，其对UC的保护作用尚未明确。本研究旨在探讨两面针根在实验性UC中的活性成分、治疗效果及可能机制。制备了两面针根乙醇提取物（ZNE），并对其化学成分进行了表征。通过给予3%葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）建立小鼠UC模型，这是一种诱导类似人类UC结肠炎的成熟方法。监测疾病状态以评估ZNE的疗效。采用ELISA、qRT-PCR、免疫组织化学、Western blotting和分子对接技术阐明ZNE抗UC的潜在机制。此外，使用细菌16S rRNA基因测序评估肠道微生物群的变化。成分表征表明，ZNE的主要成分为生物碱，包括木兰花碱（magnoflorine）、地奥司明（diosmin）、橙皮苷（hesperidin）、血根碱（sanguinarine）、氯化两面针碱（nitidine chloride）、白屈菜红碱（chelerythrine）、茵芋碱（skimmianine）和L-芝麻素（L-sesamin）。动物实验显示，ZNE治疗显著减轻了DSS诱导结肠炎的表现，降低了DAI评分和组织学损伤，其效果优于阳性药物5-ASA。此外，ZNE显著降低了促炎细胞因子水平，同时增强了抗炎因子。机制上，ZNE通过激活PPARgamma、抑制IkappaBalpha磷酸化并阻止NF-kappaB p65核转位，从而抑制iNOS表达，显著调节PPARgamma/NF-kappaB/iNOS信号通路。然而，ZNE在缓解UC和调节PPARgamma/NF-kappaB/iNOS信号通路中的作用被PPAR-gamma拮抗剂GW9662处理部分消除，表明ZNE通过激活PPARgamma发挥其活性。分子对接分析显示，ZNE中的上述八种生物碱通过与PPARgamma活性位点中的关键氨基酸残基相互作用，表现出显著的结合亲和力。此外，ZNE通过恢复肠道微生物群平衡来缓解UC，具体表现为促进有益菌如拟杆菌门（Bacteroidetes）、紫单胞菌科（Porphyromonadaceae）、普雷沃氏菌科（Prevotellaceae）和嗜黏蛋白阿克曼菌（Akkermansia_muciniphila）的比例，同时降低厚壁菌门/拟杆菌门（Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes）比率以及变形菌门（Proteobacteria）、肠杆菌科（Enterobacteriaceae）、拟杆菌属（Bacteroides）、酸拟杆菌（Bacteroides_acidifaciens）和大肠杆菌（Escherichia）的丰度。相关性分析结果表明，这些改变的细菌与结肠炎相关参数密切相关。总之，本研究首次证明ZNE对UC具有显著保护作用，且ZNE的主要活性成分为生物碱。其抗结肠炎机制涉及调节PPARgamma/NF-kappaB/iNOS信号通路和恢复肠道微生物群稳态。
